collection.title: Audi A1 Hatchback (3 Door) 2010 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2010 - 2018 version of the Audi A1 Hatchback which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this A1 Hatchback which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
